_doc: CI benchmark datasets (run_ci.py). Key = name on the CI page. fetch = dataset of ../reproduce/fetch_spectra.sh (spectra land in <data>/<fetch>/), database = file in <data>/databases/ (../reproduce/build_databases.sh). entrapment: report the true FDP. quant: design + amounts (as in ../quant-eval) for the ratio accuracy of an --lfq --mbr run.

PXD001819.description: Low-res LFQ, yeast + natural E. coli entrapment (UPS1)

PXD070049.description: Astral HCD, Human/Yeast/E. coli, one run

proteobench-astral.description: Astral LFQ + MBR, Human/Yeast/E. coli, 6 runs
